rear-wiper-automatic-activation.note: Washer.MQB_09_AutoRearWiper: 09 DID 0D20, new BCM bit0.4 / old BCM bit0.3 (MQBAlternativeContainerForUnit09).

low-ambient-temperature-warning.note: Cluster 17 050E byte13 "Icy Weather Warning Upper Threshold" (°C, raw-10); default 4 °C. The low threshold (byte14, csadapt-10185) is the hysteresis bound and is left alone - keep it below the new value.

coming-home-time.note: BCM 09 0A57 byte5, seconds. New-gen BCM container only; old BCM (0D04) has no duration channel in the vendor data.

start-stop-system-deactivation.note: Climatronic 08 0600 byte8 bit4 'Start Stop Function Deactivation Climate Unit Method': vendor ENABLE = 0, DISABLE = 1, shown as On (Start/Stop works) / Off. Which value means permanent-off is not stated in the vendor data; the On/Off reading assumes ENABLE/DISABLE name the Start/Stop function. Needs a live check.

remote-trunk-release.note: B7 0579 byte0 bit4 "Tailgate Opening And Closing From Key Fob" - works where a Kessy/B7 unit exists.

navigation-compass-in-dashboard.note: Cluster 17 0600 byte10 bit6. Compass position (byte9 bit3, csadapt-10184) is a separate optional setting.

hazard-switch-brightness.note: BCM 09 09DB byte55 'Interior Brightness After Ignition Was Turned On (%)', 0 = off. UNVERIFIED match: the vendor label names interior brightness, not the hazard switch. The hazard-switch LED itself is a lamp record (vendor tables disagree: PQ26-style 055B 'WARNBLK TASTER C54' vs MQB 055F '35 LED Warnblinktaster C48'; the Kushaq reads 055B/055E/055F as type-0x24 LEDs at dim AB 0x64), whose dim byte would be the direct channel. Confirm with a capture before trusting this mapping.

easy-entry.note: Requires driver seat with memory. 3 parts: 36 0600, 5F 0B3C/0B1B, 5F 0B3D/0B1D.

easy-entry-for-passenger.note: Requires seats with memory. 4 parts: 06 0600, 5F 0B3C/0B1B, 5F 0B3D/0B1D, 36 0600 bit6.4.

allow-car-settings-while-moving.note: MIB3 only: 5F 0B1B byte23 bit5 '[MIB3] Dashboard settings in MMI: Over threshold high' - unlocks the dashboard (instrument cluster) settings menu above the speed threshold. The recipe refuses on MIB2.5 or an unidentified head unit (when.mib3).

am-radio.note: MIB2.5 0600 byte14 bit1 / MIB3 0559 byte4 bit7, inverted (Enabled = 0).
